crossRefs.note: Hear, heavens, and listen, earth; for Yahweh has spoken: “I have nourished and brought up children and they have…
Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,
both low and high, rich and poor together.
The Mighty One, God, Yahweh, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.
O earth, earth, earth, hear Yahweh’s word!
Hear, you mountains, Yahweh’s controversy, and you enduring foundations of the earth; for Yahweh has a controversy with…
He will lift up a banner to the nations from far away, and he will whistle for them from the end of the earth. Behold…
It will happen in that day that Yahweh will whistle for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt…
Set up a banner on the bare mountain! Lift up your voice to them! Wave your hand, that they may go into the gates of…
The noise of a multitude is in the mountains, as of a great people; the noise of an uproar of the kingdoms of the…
Yahweh, your hand is lifted up, yet they don’t see; but they will see your zeal for the people, and be disappointed.…
Does the trumpet alarm sound in a city, without the people being afraid? Does evil happen to a city, and Yahweh hasn’t…
Yahweh’s voice calls to the city, and wisdom sees your name: “Listen to the rod, and he who appointed it.
Yahweh will be seen over them; and his arrow will go flash like lightning; and the Lord Yahweh will blow the trumpet…
He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
“But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.

translations.web: All you inhabitants of the world, and you dwellers on the earth, when a banner is lifted up on the mountains, look! When the trumpet is blown, listen!
translations.bsb: All you people of the world and dwellers of the earth, when a banner is raised on the mountains, you will see it; when a ram’s horn sounds, you will hear it.
translations.kjv: All ye inhabitants of the world, and dwellers on the earth, see ye, when he lifteth up an ensign on the mountains; and when he bloweth a trumpet, hear
translations.asv: All ye inhabitants of the world, and ye dwellers on the earth, when an ensign is lifted up on the mountains, see ye; and when the trumpet is blown, hear ye.
